description: This file defines the main React application component for a persona builder interface. It manages UI states, document uploads, backend orchestration triggers, persona data fetching and coercion, version history, and user interactions. It contains React hooks, state management, and UI layout for the persona generation workflow in a Next.js front-end project.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into a sanitized string array, filtering out non-string or empty values.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value into a prettified JSON string, with fallback to string conversion on error.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable message from various error object types.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties in an object following a specified path, returning the value and path used.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs top-level and nested 'artifacts' keys of an object for debugging orchestration payload shapes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the persona JSON object from an orchestration record based on a prioritized list of candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData shape, handling legacy and new formats.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the persona builder workflow, including upload, orchestration triggers, persona display, and version history.
